description: OSRM provides a C++ shortest-path routing engine with OpenStreetMap import and configurable car, bicycle and walking profiles. The provider is Project OSRM. Geographical and temporal coverage: The project supports continental-sized user networks; no fixed reference date is built into the software. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is BSD-2-Clause. The described material is available without a stated fee.
